title: CodeScaler: Scaling Code LLM Training and Test-Time Inference via Execution-Free Reward Models
authors_zh: Xiao Zhu、Xinyu Zhou、Boyu Zhu、Hanxu Hu、Mingzhe Du、Haotian Zhang、Huiming Wang、Zhijiang Guo
paper_type_zh: 代码偏好数据、无执行奖励模型与推理时选择方法
best_for_zh: 需要代码偏好对、代码奖励模型或免执行候选重排方法的研究者
one_line: CodeScaler releases 51,107 verified code preference pairs for training execution-free reward models that scale code training and test-time selection.
CodeScalerPair-51K 含 51,107 个经验证的代码候选偏好对，以无执行奖励模型支持代码推理训练与 test-time 选择。
why: It targets the practical setting where executing every candidate program is too costly while retaining pairwise reward supervision.
inclusion_reason: CodeScaler releases verified code preference pairs and an execution-free reward-model recipe for both preference training and inference-time selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code RLVR usually depends on unit tests, but high-quality tests are expensive and incomplete, and execution latency limits scaling to synthetic problems and test-time candidate selection. General reward models also struggle to identify code syntax and functional differences reliably.

CodeScaler builds pairwise preferences from on-policy code generations verified by real tests and trains a code reward model that scores a problem and solution without executing tests, using the model for both RL training and test-time selection.

代码 RLVR 通常依赖单元测试给出可执行奖励，但高质量测试昂贵、覆盖不完整，并使大规模合成题和 test-time 多候选选择受到执行延迟限制。现有通用奖励模型又常不能稳定识别代码语法和功能差异。

CodeScaler 用已通过真实测试验证的 on-policy 代码生成构造成对偏好，训练能够直接读题目与代码、无需执行测试即可打分的代码奖励模型，并把它同时用于 RL 训练和推理时选择。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: CodeScaler builds pairwise preferences from on-policy code generations verified by real tests and trains a code reward model that scores a problem and solution without executing tests, using the model for both RL training and test-time selection. The official CodeScalerPair-51K release contains 51,107 English code-preference pairs from Qwen3-8B-Base on-policy GRPO rollouts over DeepCoder problems. Code passing every test becomes code_pos, any failing code becomes code_neg, and question_content is retained. The public Parquet dataset is the raw pre-augmentation set under MIT.

CodeScaler 用已通过真实测试验证的 on-policy 代码生成构造成对偏好，训练能够直接读题目与代码、无需执行测试即可打分的代码奖励模型，并把它同时用于 RL 训练和推理时选择。官方 CodeScalerPair-51K 含 51,107 个英文代码偏好对，来自 Qwen3-8B-Base 在 DeepCoder 题目上的 GRPO on-policy rollout；通过全部测试的代码为 code_pos，任一测试失败的代码为 code_neg，并保留 question_content。公开集为论文增强前的 raw pair，Parquet 格式、MIT 许可。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Run GRPO with Qwen3-8B-Base on executable DeepCoder problems and collect on-policy candidate code throughout training.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Execute candidates in the original test environment; mark all-pass code positive and any-fail code negative, then pair responses from the same problem.
  1. Verify and filter: Train 1.7B, 4B, and 8B CodeScaler models with syntax-aware extraction and validity-preserving reward shaping so formatting noise does not dominate scores.
  1. Train and evaluate: Use CodeScaler instead of test execution for rollout rewards during RL and batch-score multiple candidates for test-time selection.

1. 建立数据源： 在 DeepCoder 可执行题目上运行 Qwen3-8B-Base 的 GRPO 训练并持续收集不同阶段的 on-policy 候选代码。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 在原测试环境中执行候选；全部通过标为正例，出现任一失败标为负例，再按同题组合成偏好对。
  1. 验证与筛选： 训练 1.7B、4B 和 8B CodeScaler，加入语法感知代码抽取与保持有效性的 reward shaping，避免格式噪声主导分数。
  1. 训练与评测： RL 时以 CodeScaler 替代测试执行给 rollout 奖励；推理时对多候选直接批量评分并选择最高分代码。

title: Evidence
证据
html: CodeScaler improves Qwen3-8B-Base by an average of 11.72 points across five coding benchmarks and exceeds binary execution-reward RL by 1.82 points. Test-time selection is comparable to unit-test methods with about 10× lower latency. It also leads prior RMs on RM-Bench by 3.3 points in code and 2.7 points on average in general/reasoning domains. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.

CodeScaler 将 Qwen3-8B-Base 在五个代码基准上的平均成绩提高 11.72 个点，比二值执行奖励 RL 再高 1.82 点；推理选择达到接近单测方法的效果而延迟约降低 10 倍。其在 RM-Bench 代码域领先已有 RM 3.3 点，并在通用与推理域平均领先 2.7 点。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior code rewards either execute tests online or use generic RMs without code-specific constraints. CodeScaler first uses execution offline to define reliable preferences, then learns a deployable execution-free proxy with explicit handling of code extraction and invalid outputs.
以往代码奖励要么实时执行测试，要么使用缺少代码专门约束的通用 RM；CodeScaler 的实际变化是先用执行结果离线定义可靠偏好，再学习一个可部署的 execution-free proxy，并专门约束代码提取和无效输出。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: The RM is only a proxy for test outcomes and may assign false positives on out-of-distribution languages, libraries, or repository tasks; it is not a proof of correctness.
  1. Feedback risk: The 51K release comes from one base policy and the DeepCoder distribution, inheriting their error modes and difficulty bias.
  1. Reproduction and use: The dataset card states that the public set is raw and unaugmented; exact reproduction requires the augmentation rules, model snapshots, and reward-shaping parameters.

1. 覆盖边界： 奖励模型只是测试结果的代理，分布外语言、库或长仓库任务中可能高分误判，不能视为形式正确性证明。
  1. 反馈风险： 公开 51K 数据来自单一 base policy 与 DeepCoder 分布，易继承其错误模式和难度覆盖偏差。
  1. 复现与使用： 数据页说明公开的是未执行论文增强的 raw pairs；严格复现需核对增强规则、模型快照和 reward shaping 参数。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Train a code ORM directly from question_content, code_pos, and code_neg with Bradley–Terry loss, calibrating it on a held-out executable set.
  1. Training: Provide approximate RL rewards for synthetic problems without tests, while periodically executing samples to estimate reward hacking.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Use it for low-latency Best-of-N code selection and report selection accuracy, actual-test pass@1, and scoring latency together.

1. 评测： 直接用 question_content、code_pos、code_neg 和 Bradley–Terry loss 训练代码 ORM，并在独立执行集上校准。
  1. 训练： 在无测试的合成题上提供近似 RL 奖励，但定期抽样执行代码以估计 reward hacking。
  1. 迁移或部署： 用于低延迟 Best-of-N 代码选择；成功标准应同时报告选择准确率、真实测试 pass@1 与评分延迟。
